spec_provided_observability.name: PxIS / IS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-port + global interrupt status; every error / completion leaves a sticky bit.

spec_provided_observability.name: PxSERR
spec_provided_observability.purpose: SCR1 error register — Link / PHY / Transport errors.

spec_provided_observability.name: PxTFD
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Shadow of device Task File — STS + ERR.

spec_provided_observability.name: PxSSTS
spec_provided_observability.purpose: SCR0 — current link state (DET / SPD / IPM).

spec_provided_observability.name: Received FIS Structure
spec_provided_observability.purpose: DSFIS / PSFIS / RFIS / SDBFIS / UFIS in system memory.

spec_provided_observability.name: BIST FIS (0x58)
spec_provided_observability.purpose: BIST Activate FIS for vendor-defined device loopback tests.

scope_observability: SATA link analyzers capture every primitive + FIS on the differential pair.
DSO on A+ / A- / B+ / B- characterizes OOB envelopes + eye diagrams + de-emphasis.
DEVSLP sideband is single-ended digital; assertion latency vs PxCMD.ICC=8h is measurable.
ate_or_dft: AHCI does not specify a JTAG / scan path. Vendor HBA silicon uses internal scan + ATPG; PHY uses BIST loopback controllable via the BIST FIS path.
notes: AHCI's debug philosophy is software-driven postmortem — every per-port status / error bit is preserved until software acknowledges it. PxSERR is bit-accumulated.
